speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

While the cholestatic labs and pruritus are classic for PBC, your history of ulcerative colitis and sexual exposure with multiple partners raises a strong possibility of Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC) or an overlap syndrome. To differentiate these, I need to see your biliary tree. REQUEST IMAGES: MRCP.
